'''Sin-bullets''' were gulletstones coughed up by [[Vashan]] [[Bodhi (Vashan)|bohdis]] as part of a religious ceremony on the moon of [[Qina/Legends|Qina]] that occurred every midwinter.

The ceremony would be held at [[Inicus Mont]].
